scope: Correct visible Head-to-specialist handoffs so they repeat two concrete decision details, retry once when malformed or generic, bind each committed task to its named specialist, and preserve the existing Head -> specialist -> Critic topology. No GoDaddy application, database, migration, reset, deletion, deployment or external upload was contacted.
required_topology: Head Consultant -> each selected specialist: task only
each selected specialist -> Critic: independent initial position
Critic -> relevant specialist -> Critic: selected-depth exchange
Head Consultant -> owner: final synthesis only

checks.name: case-specific Head handoff
checks.observed: Every accepted Head task must contain a case anchor and a second detail from the owner decision. Invalid, owner-facing or generic output is retried once; the final safe fallback contains the stated decision and a recipient-specific focus instead of a static role template.
